items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I remember a few times we had different people sit in with us with Buddy’s band, like Erroll Garner sat in and a lot of the drummers, Philly Joe Jones and Mel Lewis and Ed Shaughnessy, and I can’t think of some of the other guys, Joe Morello.

ctx.x: Wow. That’s what I wanted to do. I remember a few times we had different people sit in with us with Buddy’s band, like Erroll Garner sat in and a lot of the drummers, Philly Joe Jones and Mel Lewis and Ed Shaughnessy, and I can’t think of some of the other guys, Joe Morello. But Philly Joe sounded so good. But Buddy of course was, he’d wipe them all out with his things. I used to call him the Art Tatum of the drums, because you know he could just do anything, it was fantastic. You used to hear 20 minute drum…
It must have been interesting to tour the whole world.
